current_suggestion.pitch: Your AI interests focus on capability — what can it do — but Robert Miles covers the complementary question of what happens as capabilities scale, which is increasingly relevant to anyone tracking AI seriously. His content is solo explainer format, technically honest without being developer-focused, and sits at the intersection of AI capability limits, alignment problems, and long-term trajectory — a perspective none of your current channels (Lex, Huberman, Rogan) cover with rigor. Videos are dense, citation-grounded, and reward slow watching rather than background listening.
